extracted.name: Classic Alfredo Sauce
extracted.description: This traditional Alfredo sauce is made with a combination of butter, cream, egg, nutmeg, and two kinds of cheese to create a luxurious pasta sauce.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Mix in cream, stirring constantly. Add Parmesan cheese, Romano cheese, nutmeg, and salt; stir constantly until cheese has melted.
Stir in egg yolk until well combined; simmer and stir over medium-low heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Garnish with additional grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
